_about: Hand-checked holdings on real public sample statements (SC-9.6). Values read from the page text and cross-checked against the statement's own printed account totals; where the sample is internally inconsistent, it says so. Labelled 2026-11-12 by an AI agent reading the public PDFs locally (no external service); spot-check before relying on it. Files: data/reference/specimen_corpus.csv, fetched with data/specimens/tools/fetch.py.
